title: On Serpent Venom Toxin
summary: Contains the recipe for Serpent Fang Toxin.

fields.Recipe: Extract three Venomous Fangs into Suspension of Snake Venom, then add any Vitriol. The book names Vitriol of Lolth’s Candle as one option.
fields.Acquisition: Locked wooden chest in the back room of the Waning Moon, X −258, Y −94.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
